resume.competencies_html:
Data Capture: Accurate data entry, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.
Event Coordination: Organizing logistics for large events, managing communications, and stakeholder liaison.
Legal Research: Conducting legal research, case law analysis, and statutory interpretation.
Communication: Fluent in Finnish and English; strong professional communication skills.

paragraphs: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Data Capture Remote Work - Urgent Hiring position at Universia México. With a background in legal studies and practical experience in data management and event coordination, I believe my skills align well with your requirements.

My experience coordinating large international events (International House Oulu) demonstrates my ability to manage logistics, communications, and stakeholder liaison effectively. This role also involved training for a digital service ('OuluBot'), which showcased my proficiency in handling data-related tasks.

Recently, I completed an internship at Asianajajatoimisto Regelin Oy, where I gained exposure to Finnish legal practice and procedures. This experience has reinforced my commitment to integrating my international legal expertise with the Finnish system.

I am confident that my ability to work independently, attention to detail, and strong communication skills in both English and Finnish will make me a valuable asset to your team at Universia México. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your organization's success.
Thank you for considering my application. I hope to hear from you soon.
